Human-in-the-loop approval gates, repository diff ownership, and optional private deployment scoping as capabilities clear certification.

challenges.title: Unverified Agent Edits

audienceSolutions.name: Enterprise & Private AI
audienceSolutions.headline: Customer-segregated AI architecture, model licensing, and disciplined technical transparency.
audienceSolutions.summary: Forger Digital Solutions is building toward private enterprise AI workforces, commercial model licensing, and developer APIs/SDKs anchored on strict data isolation, Apache 2.0 open-weight foundations, and verifiable evaluation evidence.

challenges.title: Data Commingling Risk
challenges.detail: Enterprises cannot risk proprietary source code, internal processes, or production IP leaking into shared training corpora.

challenges.title: Hype vs. Verifiable Readiness
challenges.detail: Procurement teams need honest separation between architecture proposals, internal evaluations, and production-certified software.

challenges.title: Licensing Clarity
challenges.detail: Commercial adopters need unambiguous upstream model licenses (such as Apache 2.0) and clear downstream ownership of customized workflows.

proposedWorkflows: Explicit 5-layer customization ladder separating Customer Retrieval, Agent Configuration, Tool Integration, Fine-Tuning, and Dedicated Model Deployment.
Zero automatic reuse of customer data to train shared FDS models; contractual and technical boundaries aligned strictly to demonstrated capability.
Transparent pre-release scoping for future commercial licensing of Hackmanite, Cinnabar, and Jaspilite enterprise editions.
audienceSolutions.availabilityBoundary: FDS does NOT claim SOC 2, ISO 27001, HIPAA, or turnkey enterprise SLAs today. Private deployments and commercial licensing are planned offerings open for early architectural discovery.

personalizationLayers.name: Approved Tool & Pipeline Integration
personalizationLayers.whatItDoes: Connects models safely to compilers, profilers, test suites, version control, asset validators, or external animation/audio pipelines under least-privilege rules.
personalizationLayers.dataBoundary: Explicit allowlists and audit logs govern every tool call; no silent external egress.

personalizationLayers.name: Domain Adaptation / Fine-Tuning (Planned)

personalizationLayers.dataBoundary: Produced adapters belong exclusively to the customer deployment and are never merged back into public or multi-tenant checkpoints.

personalizationLayers.dataBoundary: Deployment scope, security controls, and contractual SLAs are established only for verified, production-ready releases.

stages.title: Independent Model Development
stages.detail: Domain specialists—Hackmanite for game engineering and Cinnabar for storytelling & animation craft—train and prove value independently.

stages.title: Certified Knowledge Exports
stages.detail: Only independently evaluated specialist checkpoints with verified licensing and reproducible traces qualify as teacher inputs.

stages.title: Collective Training
stages.detail: Dedicated cross-domain training run designed to unify reasoning across software, games, storytelling, and scientific domains.

stages.title: Multi-Teacher Distillation
stages.detail: Structured transfer of verified specialist reasoning traces without naive weight averaging or unverified parameter merging.

stages.title: Independent Evaluation
stages.detail: Holdout benchmarks across every source domain plus cross-domain synthesis, measuring raw vs. guarded reliability and regressions.

stages.title: Future Commercial Deployment
stages.detail: Public availability, developer APIs, or studio licensing occur only after independent capability certification and owner approval.

orchestrationVsCollective.orchestration: Routes tasks dynamically across multiple separate models and tools at runtime (e.g., Jaspilite Auto & Meld modes).
orchestrationVsCollective.collective: Trains a single unified neural model via multi-teacher distillation and curated cross-domain training (Alexandrite vision).

orchestrationVsCollective.orchestration: Combines outputs via prompts, handoffs, and shared workspace state; each model still reasons inside its own weights.
orchestrationVsCollective.collective: Internalizes cross-domain abstractions (e.g., game physics + narrative staging + systems engineering) inside shared latent representations.

orchestrationVsCollective.orchestration: Not applicable — models remain distinct weights invoked selectively.
orchestrationVsCollective.collective: Simply averaging unrelated weights or combining model names degrades coherence; disciplined distillation & holdout evals are mandatory.

orchestrationVsCollective.orchestration: Active platform development inside Jaspilite; does NOT depend on Alexandrite to deliver value.
orchestrationVsCollective.collective: Research vision; collective training has not started and no Alexandrite weights or API exist today.
